results.title: Adobe Semrush Deal Aims To Recast AI Marketing And Search Workflows
results.content:
Adobe has completed its acquisition of Semrush Holdings, adding AI driven brand visibility and marketing tools to its portfolio.
 The deal expands Adobe's capabilities in SEO, agentic search optimization and digital discoverability for enterprise customers.
 The transaction comes alongside broader launches in Adobe's enterprise AI products and partnerships with large marketing groups. [...] The Semrush acquisition plugs directly into Adobe's push to own more of the brand visibility and customer experience stack, rather than just offering isolated creative tools. By combining Semrush's search and AI-driven visibility data with Adobe Experience Manager, CX Enterprise and GenStudio, Adobe is positioning its platform as a single system that can sense how a brand shows up across search and AI interfaces, adjust content, and push changes into campaigns. Partnerships with Omnicom, DICK'S [...] 🎁 Potential for more comprehensive, AI-driven marketing workflows that tie together search visibility, content production and personalization inside one vendor relationship.
 🎁 The acquisition, alongside the US$25b buyback, may reinforce Adobe's positioning as a scaled, full-stack provider for enterprise marketing and CX budgets rather than just a creative software vendor.

results.title: Adobe AI-first ARR triples, Q2 revenue hits record $6.62B
results.content:
## Acquisition strategy: Topaz Labs and the imaging stack

Alongside the financial results, Adobe announced a pending acquisition of Topaz Labs, a developer known for AI-powered image and video enhancement tools widely used by professional photographers and post-production teams, per a Business Wire report via Yahoo Finance. Topaz Labs' core capabilities in upscaling, noise reduction, and sharpening are technically complementary to Adobe's existing Photoshop and Premiere Pro pipelines. [...] The move follows Adobe's earlier acquisition of Rephrase.AI, which added synthetic video and avatar generation capabilities aimed at e-commerce and digital marketing workflows, also reported via Yahoo Finance. Together, the acquisitions signal that Adobe is filling out the full generative media stack, from still imaging and video enhancement to AI-generated presenters, rather than relying solely on organic Firefly development.
